title: U.S. Energy Information Administration — Weekly U.S. Regular All Formulations Retail Gasoline Prices
notes: Cost-watch news feed only, not a durable page. State the price as of its date only; do NOT attribute it to any geopolitical cause (nonpartisan screen). Print $4.33 or $4.331, never $4.04 (truncation) and never $3.049 (digit misread - an automated fetch returned that once). This value is superseded 2026-10-20.
display_caption: Regular gasoline averaged $4.33 a gallon nationwide in the week ending 12 October 2026.
receipt: EIA Weekly U.S. Regular All Formulations Retail Gasoline Prices (EMM_EPMR_PTE_NUS_DPG), $/gal: 4.331 (week ending 2026-10-12); 4.354 (week ending 2026-10-05, prior published value); 3.061 (week ending 2025-10-13, year earlier). Includes taxes; regular grade; national volume-weighted. Read off the EIA table on 2026-10-17; page states release date 10/14/2026, next release 10/20/2026.

title: U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics — CPI Average Price Data, Ground beef, 100% beef, per lb.
notes: Food headline stat. Never "record high". Print the level to the cent ($6.79), never truncated. No causal framing. October 2025 is missing from the series ("Data unavailable due to the 2025 lapse in appropriations") - never use it as an endpoint; a window whose two endpoints both exist (e.g. January 2019 - August 2026) is fine. September 2026 level is superseded by the October 2026 CPI release (2026-11-10) - re-pull once that is published.
display_caption: Ground beef cost $6.79 a pound in September 2026, up from $3.80 in January 2019 — about 79% more.
receipt: BLS CPI Average Price Data, "Ground beef, 100% beef, per lb. (453.6 gm) in U.S. city average" (APU0000703112), $/lb: 6.792 (September 2026); 6.923 (August 2026); 6.323 (September 2025); 3.801 (January 2019). Same-series computation: (6.792 / 3.801 - 1) x 100 = 78.7% (about 79%). September 2025, August 2026 and September 2026 read from the BLS Average Retail Food and Energy Prices, U.S. and South Region table on 2026-10-17; January 2019 carried from the previous receipt (read off data.bls.gov/timeseries/APU0000703112 on 2026-10-10).
